BiblicalUsage: Charosheth is mechanical work, the skilled cutting of stone and carving of timber for the tabernacle, given to Bezalel and his workmen.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word honours the hands: God filled men with skill to cut stone and carve wood for His house.
